content:
Here's an example of a spam attempt in a chat:

**User1**: Hey! How's your day going?

**SpammerBot47**: 🎉 CONGRATULATIONS! You've been selected as our LUCKY WINNER! Click here to claim your $500 Amazon gift card: bit.ly/totally-not-a-scam 💰 Limited time offer! Act now!!!

**User1**: Uh, I didn't enter any contest...

**SpammerBot47**: 🔥 AMAZING WEIGHT LOSS PILLS! Lose 30 pounds in 10 days GUARANTEED! Doctors HATE this one simple trick! Order now at: sketchy-pills-dot-com 🔥 Use code SPAM50 for discount!

**User1**: Please stop. I'm reporting this.

**SpammerBot47**: Make $3000/week working from home! No experience needed! Just send $99 processing fee to get started! Message me your credit card info! 💳💰

This example shows typical spam characteristics: unsolicited promotional content, urgency tactics, suspicious links, unrealistic claims, and requests for personal/financial information.
